items.observation: Coordinates are found one at a time from the section ratio, then midpoint and distance calculations are written through to the selected choice. This is a useful floor for explicit substitution and intermediate values.
Coordinate differences are stated before the distance formula, followed by square and radical simplification on separate lines; prose identifies why the formula applies.
Each set relation is separately checked and justified, including the invalid subset notation. This sets the floor for option-by-option blocks.
The solution makes both perpendicular side-vector cases explicit, rejects the point outside the first quadrant, and computes the diameter midpoint and radius before the final expression.
